m.aarti.tek: Om, victory to you, Mother Gaṅgā; victory to you, Mother! Whoever meditates on you gains the fruit his heart desires.
m.aarti.pad1: Your radiance is like the moon's, and your water flows pure. Whoever falls at your refuge crosses over (the ocean of worldly life).
m.aarti.pad2: You delivered the sons of King Sagara, as the whole world knows. When your gracious glance falls, you give happiness in all three worlds.
m.aarti.pad3: Any being who comes to your refuge even once is freed from the terror of Yama and attains the supreme state.
m.aarti.pad4: O Mother, whoever sings your āratī every day, that servant easily attains liberation.
